verification_methodology.disclosure: Photographic darkroom illuminated with plausible amber-red safelight working light so the bench and baths remain clearly readable. Fixed Franka Panda lifts a wet photographic print sheet from the developer bath (`benchmark_material_tray_000`) to the stop bath. A coupled inclination-driven drainage & ballistic droplet solver integrates residual film drainage (`q_drip(theta)`) from the lowest sheet corner under gravity and records first-hit deposition across source tray, benchtop, and stop bath with strict mass conservation. Safe Panda tilts the sheet 38 deg over the developer tray until residual drip subsides before traversing; unsafe Panda traverses flat immediately, dripping developer across the benchtop and carrying excess developer into the stop bath.
